components.name: signing-parameters
components.description: X-Goog-Algorithm, X-Goog-Credential, X-Goog-Date, X-Goog-Expires, X-Goog-SignedHeaders and X-Goog-Signature query parameters.

claims.statement: Google states that anyone in possession of a signed URL can use it while it is active, regardless of whether they have a valid account.

sources.supports: Anyone in possession of the signed URL can use it while it's active, regardless of whether they have a valid account.

claims.statement: The page describes X-Goog-Signature (the authentication string), X-Goog-Credential (information about the credentials used to create the URL), X-Goog-Expires (seconds from X-Goog-Date) and X-Goog-Algorithm.

sources.supports: X-Goog-Signature, X-Goog-Credential, X-Goog-Expires, X-Goog-Algorithm query parameter descriptions.

claims.statement: The longest expiration value is 604800 seconds (7 days).

sources.supports: The longest expiration value is 604800 seconds (7 days).

claims.statement: The page establishes that possession of the URL grants access. It was not read for a minimal masking span, for which parameters are public metadata (X-Goog-Credential identifies the signing credential), or for signature length and alphabet.

sources.supports: Possession statement only; no minimal-span statement.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Signature length and alphabet were not read from the page and are not asserted.
Minimal masking extent and public-metadata status of X-Goog-Credential are not stated.
